subject: Intro request: aligning buying circle & econ buyer for HelmBio pilot
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@helmbio.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-16T14:12:00Z
Subject: Quick recap + request: econ buyer / procurement intro

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap on our end and two asks so we can keep momentum: 

Notes from the call (high level)
- Use case: internal docs summarization + anonymized analytics for R&D teams
- Initial scope: 3 models, ~25k tokens/day, expected pilot 8 weeks
- Primary success criteria: latency < 500ms p50, cost <$0.02/token equivalent for batch runs, no PHI in inputs

Asks / next steps
1) Could you introduce me to whoever owns the budget for R&D tooling (economic buyer)? We want to understand budget cadence and approval thresholds so we scope an appropriate pilot.
2) Can you loop in procurement and the security/legal contact who will own the questionnaire? I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a link to our security questionnaire (short checklist) to speed triage.

Proposed short call: 30 minutes with your econ buyer, procurement and one of our solutions engineers (Jasmine) next week. I pasted a couple of time options below. If none work, happy to adapt.

Times (PST):
- Tue 5/23 10:00–10:30
- Wed 5/24 14:00–14:30

Attachments: [Attachment: HelmBio_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP, 2 pages)] [Security checklist link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bHelmBioMAP]

Thanks — I’ll keep Aditya (AE) on copy so he can coordinate commercial/contract questions.

Best,
Monica Patel
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
[Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai]
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@helmbio.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Olsen <sara.olsen@helmbio.com>, procurement@helmbio.com
Date: 2028-05-16T18:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap + request: econ buyer / procurement intro

Hi Monica — thanks for the summary and clear asks. Looping in two folks:
- Sara Olsen (Head of Finance) — she typically signs off on pilot spends up to $50k and coordinates with CFO for larger commitments.
- procurement@helmbio.com — procurement intake and SOW templates live with this alias.

Sara and procurement team — Monica from Redwood led product discussion and sent a MAP + security checklist. Monica — Sara is the budget owner for R&D initiatives; she'll confirm timing and any PO process requirements.

I can join a short intro call if helpful, but Sara and procurement will own the procurement path. If you want to share an initial target budget range to make scheduling easier, that helps us too.

Cheers,
Alex Carter
Head of Product, HelmBio
alex.carter@helmbio.com | +1 (617) 555-2121

- Confirmation that Sara is the budget owner and OK to evaluate a ~$25k–$40k pilot (we can size smaller or larger depending on objectives)

1) 10m — introductions + decision roles / timeline
2) 10m — proposed pilot scope & acceptance criteria (Jasmine)
3) 10m — procurement & next steps (Aditya)

Availability (PST) — we can run any of these:
- Tue 5/23 10:00–10:30
- Wed 5/24 14:00–14:30
- Thu 5/25 08:30–09:00 (if you want an early slot)

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: HelmBio_MAP_v1.pdf] [Link to Redwood security questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bHelmBioMAP]

Thanks — happy to adapt to your process.
